name: Cooperage Inn

evidence.note: Restaurant's Fall Festival page lists Nitework (Oct 3) and Slingshot (Oct 4); the outdoor festival runs weekends, noon to 6 PM.
Article describes the large outdoor festival area with a beer tent and live bands that draw a big crowd.
A band's listing for its Oct 10 festival set calls it an 80s dance party (band's own words).

dancing.notes: The Fall Festival is outdoors, with bands playing in the afternoon for a big crowd. Bands bill some sets as dance parties, so expect casual dancing on the grass near the band.

description: A country-style restaurant on Sound Avenue in wine country. On fall weekends it runs an outdoor festival with food, a beer tent and live cover bands on the lawn.
reviewNotes:
Added from Ira's List research (2026-10-03). Some listings say Calverton; Baiting Hollow is the hamlet (ZIP 11933 is shared). Dancing judgement is based on event descriptions, not photos or reviews.

Directory research 2026-10-04: Current description is still accurate, so no new one. The logo is a white wordmark on a transparent background; it needs a dark background to be visible. Baiting Hollow is a hamlet in the Town of Riverhead (the site itself writes 'Baiting Hollow (Calverton)'). Dancing is at the outdoor Fall Festival band stage on the lawn; no indoor dance floor is mentioned. A reservations link goes to OpenTable (opentable.com/restaurant/profile/67750), not recorded.
hours: Sun-Thu 11:30 AM-8 PM; Fri-Sat 11:30 AM-9 PM. Outdoor Fall Festival: weekends 12 PM-6 PM, weekend after Labor Day through late October (weather permitting)

logo.alt: Cooperage Inn logo: the words Cooperage Inn in white outlined capital letters

photos.alt: The front of the Cooperage Inn: a white farmhouse-style building with a curved blue sign, an arched entrance, patio tables and flowers
A cover band playing under a blue tent on the lawn at the Cooperage Inn Fall Festival, with guests standing in front and pennant flags overhead
The Cooperage Inn's garden patio with green-clothed tables, white umbrellas and potted plants

evidence.note: Restaurant site footer: 2218 Sound Avenue, Baiting Hollow (Calverton) NY 11933, 631.727.8994, info@cooperageinn.com, hours Sun-Thu 11:30am-8pm and Fri-Sat 11:30am-9pm; links Facebook and Instagram.
Fall Festival page lists a cover band every Saturday and Sunday (Sept 12-Oct 25, 2026) and says it is outdoors, weekends only 12-6 PM, separate from indoor dining.
A places listing for Cooperage Inn (American restaurant) matches the address, phone, hours and the same Facebook and Instagram pages.
